name: About OnlyUpload at Unbreakable
value: • OnlyUpload are torrents where download is not counted but upload is. Good for building your Ratio up. (On the Jackett dashboard search results these are tagged as Freeleech).

name: Results Per Page
value: For best results, change the Torrents pro Seite: setting to 100 on your UserCP page. The default is 15.

name: Account Inactivity
value: Inactive accounts are automatically deleted after 42 days.

name: Seeding Hours
value: Before using this indexer, make sure that you have set Meine Seedzeit on your UserCP page.
